settings.title: A studio built on the details

settings.editor: CleanCut Auto Shield is a Portland based automotive protection and restyling studio specializing in paint protection film, ceramic car coatings, window tint and vinyl wraps. Our love for cars, years of industry experience and eye for detail, is what brought CleanCut Auto Shield to life. We are a small team of dedicated artists that take pride in not only protecting vehicles, but adding personalized style and flare.

image.alt: BMW iX with paint protection film in Portland

settings.editor: Our zone of genius is correcting, protecting and customizing vehicles. Our team is highly trained, certified and we are dedicated to the details.
The highest quality films, installed by industry certified and experienced PPF installers. Choose from partial or full PPF, and even infused color PPF.
Add protection, intense gloss, shine, and eliminate the need to wax with a high quality ceramic coating.
Remove surface imperfections, including swirl marks, marring and webbing with our single stage or multi stage paint correction service.
Color infused PPF is the best combination of protection and style. Paint protection film comes in a variety of colors so that you give your vehicle ultimate protection and style.
Change the color of your vehicle with a color change wrap from one of Portland's leading vinyl wrap installers.
Add ceramic window tint to any PPF, ceramic coating or vehicle wrap package. Protect your passengers from harmful UV rays while adding security and privacy to your ride.
We never cut corners, are incredibly detailed and utilize the best products and materials in the industry.

Our team of paint protection and vehicle customization experts are extensively trained and certified. We are certified installers for 3M Paint Protection Film, Pearl Nano Ceramic Coating installers and hold a Xkote Renewal Certification.
Our brand-new Portland facility is fully equipped with premium tools and equipment to ensure we provide the best paint protection services to each and every client.
Our team is committed to excellence from the moment you contact us to our service preparation, install process and post care instructions.

Our experience, expertise and passion for what we do separates us from all the other shops in Portland. We truly love customizing and protecting cars just as much as we love showing drivers the finished results.
We stand behind our installation and quality process with a lifetime workmanship warranty.

Amazing customer service. The work that was done on my vehicle was beyond my expectations. Everything went very smooth from beginning to finish. Everything Sous said was 100% accurate. I will recommend this place all of my family and friends.

I got a brand new Lexus and I wanted some peace of mind knowing that I am protected out on the road. Sous is the nicest person and explained everything to me. I got full PPF on the front along with ceramic coating, and ceramic window tint and let me just say wow I'm so impressed.
